note.question: How should the price-setting newsvendor problem with parametric operational data analytics (ODA) be solved?
note.overview: This paper studies the data-integrated, price-setting newsvendor problem in which the price–demand relationship is described by some parametric model with unknown parameters. The paper develops the operational data analytics (ODA) formulation of this problem that features a data-integration model and a validation model. The data-integration model consists of a class of functions called the operational statistics.
